name: Ironweld
detailed_description:
You are a mech. You collect iron. You fight when programmed to fight. But unlike every other mech trapped in endless cycles, you make a decision to end this and build something better.

Ironweld lets you rebuild combat from the ground up. Create mechs that fight with perfect counter timing, strategic ability rotations, or devastating rhythmic combos. In a world where every mech extracts and fights the same way, you discovered that everything can be different.

TRANSFORM HOW 2D COMBAT WORKS

Rebuild your fighting experience completely.

  • True Combat Customization: Replace every single attack in 11 different move categories. Ground combos, air attacks, directional strikes, special moves, even your movement animations. This level of customization has never existed in 2D.

  • Unique Combat Styles: Build mechs that focus on perfect counter timing. Create others around strategic ability rotations. Master devastating rhythmic combos that chain in ways you've never seen before. Each approach feels completely different.

  • Shared Foundation: Every mech you face is built from the same foundation you are. They use the same animation systems, the same possibilities. The difference is in the choices each one made about how to fight.

  • Power That Builds: Every fight starts humble and escalates to explosive climax. Channel combat energy naturally, then unleash devastating super moves when the moment is perfect. Feel your power grow through spectacle, not just numbers

FORGE YOUR COMBAT IDENTITY

Every choice reshapes your entire fighting experience.

  • Complete Combat Reconstruction: Transform every aspect of how you fight. Replace your ground attacks, air combos, directional moves, special techniques, even your movement and defense animations. This isn't selecting presets. This is rebuilding combat from the ground up.

  • Strategic Equipment: Install parts that fundamentally alter your capabilities. Focus on close quarters dominance, combo expression, lifestealing aggression, or defensive mastery. Mix approaches to create fighting styles that have never existed.

  • Expandable Systems: Purchase additional move slots and part points to unlock deeper complexity. The more you invest, the more impossible your mech becomes.

  • Focused Exploration: Linear progression that respects your time. Move forward, always forward, like a mech learning it doesn't have to repeat the same cycles forever.

BREAK THE CYCLE

Where lore meets purpose.

  • The Cycle: Like every mech, you extract iron endlessly. Until one day, you ask "why can't we fix this instead of just surviving it?" Combat becomes your tool for change, and each enemy represents a different response to evolution. Some resist, others embrace it.

  • What happens when a mech starts asking "why?" You discover something every machine fears: the ability to choose. Not just what to do, but HOW to do it in ways that have never been possible. In a world where every mech extracts the same, fights the same, dies the same—you discovered that everything can evolve.

  • Meaningful Progression: No grinding, no random loot. Every currency choice matters. Every move purchase transforms how you experience combat. Every part equipped changes your entire fighting identity.

This isn't about choosing between preset characters or weapon types. This is about discovering that 2D combat can do everything you've wanted it to do. A mech questioned its programming. A developer refused to accept 2D combat limitations. What will you refuse to accept?

"IF I HAVE DONE IT, YOU CAN DO IT TOO"

short_description: 2D Action RPG where you battle as the mech that broke its programming to save everyone else. Transform every aspect of how you fight, discover new fighting styles, and grow powerful enough to end the endless cycle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card
